column4: A small kitchen knife cutting through mushroom stems close to wet ground, slow careful slicing, moss tearing, an old wicker basket creaking, outdoors at night, quiet
An old woman's spine cracking loudly as she straightens up from bending over, several dry pops of joints, close, outdoors at night
An old woman humming a slow old folk lullaby to herself under her breath while she works, a few metres away, outdoors at night, slightly off key
A light bulb being unscrewed from a metal lamp socket, glass squeaking against metal, then dropped softly into a wicker basket among other bulbs that clink
Rubber boots walking quickly through wet grass straight towards the listener, a wicker basket creaking with each step, outdoors at night
A short knife slash low at the ankles, cloth and skin cut, a wet slice, very close, horror
Soft wet earth cracking open as mushrooms push up out of the ground all around, small damp pops, very quiet and close, eerie
